script.textEN: What are you going to do with that vase?
script.textCN: 你打算怎么处理那个花瓶？

script.textEN: I'm going to put it on this table.
script.textCN: 我准备把它放在这张桌子上。

script.textEN: Give it to me. I'm going to put it in front of the window.
script.textCN: 把它给我。我准备把它放在窗户前面。

script.textEN: Put it here, on this shelf. There we are!
script.textCN: 把它放在这儿，这个架子上。好啦！
